title: City Strike
tagline: Hold the city against AI squads, wave after wave.
description: A third-person shooter across a city of glass towers, shops, parking lots and a fountain plaza. AI squads see, hear and talk to each other; they patrol, flank, strafe, break for cover behind cars and street furniture, and hunt down your last position. Clear every wave to secure the city — supply drops between waves, headshots and accuracy count.
scoring: 100 points a kill (150 a headshot), 250 a cleared wave, times the difficulty; accuracy adds up to a fifth.
controls: WASD to move, Shift to sprint, Space to jump
Mouse to look, left button to fire, right to aim, R to reload
Gamepad: sticks, triggers, A jump, X reload
Touch: left thumb moves, right side looks, on-screen fire / aim / reload / jump
